scope: Six bounded D2 pure action/UI helpers. Explicit target and independent consumer predicates select whole-source membership before reads. No environment/preset/key selects a historical implementation.

notes: Presentation-only summaries preserve code-point-aware truncation and the existing binary-search font-fit algorithm. Summary strings are not persisted values or canonical command arguments.
Initial real consumer: typed command palette. Release-review comment consumers are recorded but their complete owner closure is not included in this bounded slice.
Pure list selection/scroll/hit-test geometry with no Minecraft imports. Preserve existing integer arithmetic and overflow behavior without semantic cleanup.
Independent real consumers: typed command palette and key-binding screen. A typed palette currently requires keyboard_profiles, but the explicit OR documents both consumer contracts.
One non-whitespace Brigadier token parser; canonical URI/string punctuation is accepted without quoting or filesystem I/O.

Initial reviewed consumers: client-program consent action and key-binding action. Future explorer/document/history/review/overlay/path consumers need their own reviewed OR extension; their lexical presence is not blanket authorization.
Stable semantic control metadata, not runtime authorization. This bounded owner is workspace panel widgets/buttons.

SFMActionButton also has an existing ManagerScreen consumer assigned to manager_editor_actions in the UI ownership ledger. Its future real consumer requires an explicit OR extension without forcing workspace/keyboard runtime. No new manager_editor_actions definition is introduced here.
Deterministic metadata errors/inventory formatting; coordinate-action heuristic validation is not a privilege check or action executor.
Current bounded owner matches ActionElement workspace consumers. The separately reviewed manager-editor consumer must add a consumer OR when implemented; do not infer whole registry closure.
Live UI focus-address interface only; no implementation mutates the game or invokes an action.
Initial real consumer: typed command palette. The SFMFocusAction consumer is recorded but its owner/closure remains separate.

consumer_evidence.method: Offline git grep -l of each exact frozen commit over platform/minecraft/src; exact lexical path mentions including declarations and tests, not complete semantic closure or runtime authority.
unresolved_owner_extensions: SFMFocusAction separate owner and runtime closure
consumer_evidence.limits: Bounded inclusion covers only reviewed current consumers; aggregate registrations/screens outside this cohort remain absent or separately authored.

actual_cli_proof.scope: Single-file renders do not imply emission; named-project dry-run proves current all-off membership only, never compilation.

regression_module.execution: not_run_by_subagent; root owns registration and Cargo gates
